scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison is used because the binding energies are the headline quantity; recomputing from total DFT energies is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. The checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper-reported gold with tolerance and verifies the coverage trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding energies for O(23) site from paper Tables I and II.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Oxygen Adsorption on Zr(0001): An ab Initio Study', Tables I and II.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text: PW91 Θ=1/4 Eb=-8.82 eV, Θ=1/2 Eb=-8.81 eV, Θ=1 Eb=-8.44 eV; LDA Θ=1/2 Eb=-9.90 eV, Θ=1 Eb=-9.46 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper; they are the target of reproduction.

outputs.description: Computed binding energies per oxygen atom for the O(23) subsurface site. The checker compares each value to a hidden reference with an absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use open-source DFT code with appropriate pseudopotentials; the exact numerical values will differ slightly from the paper due to implementation differences. The hidden tolerance accounts for this spread. The reference energies from step_01 are not scored but are necessary for step_02.

steps.description: Check all binding energy values against paper gold within ±0.2 eV, and verify coverage trend.
